function.name: impl_from_IPropertyPageSite
function.description: This function retrieves the containing record for the given interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to get the containing record of.

function.return_type: PropertyPageSite pointer, representing the containing record of the given interface pointer.

function.name: property_sheet_proc
function.description: This function handles the initialization, display, and destruction of a property page. It is a callback function that is called when a dialog box is created, moved, resized, or destroyed.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the dialog box.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: The message.

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

function.return_type: INT_PTR, represents a pointer to the function that is the window procedure for the dialog box. It returns FALSE if it processes the message, otherwise it returns FALSE.

function.name: PropertyPageSite_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IPropertyPageSite. If it does, it assigns the interface pointer to the output parameter and increases its reference count. If it doesn't, it sets the output parameter to NULL and returns an error code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that is being queried

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of the pointer variable that receives the interface pointer

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, and E_NOINTERFACE otherwise

function.name: PropertyPageSite_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of a PropertyPageSite object and returns the new count.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IPropertyPageSite interface object.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the new reference count after incrementing.

function.name: PropertyPageSite_Release
function.description: This function decrements the reference count of the PropertyPageSite object. If the reference count becomes zero, it frees the memory allocated to the object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the IPropertyPageSite interface of the PropertyPageSite object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the PropertyPageSite object after decrementing.

function.name: PropertyPageSite_OnStatusChange
function.description: This function traces the interface and flag values and returns a status code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: 32-bit unsigned integer representing flags

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a status code indicating success or failure of the function

function.name: PropertyPageSite_GetLocaleID
function.description: This function retrieves the locale identifier from the PropertyPageSite object and assigns it to the provided pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IPropertyPageSite interface.

parameters.name: pLocaleID
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the locale identifier.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation was successful.

function.name: PropertyPageSite_GetPageContainer
function.description: This function is not implemented yet and returns a 'not implemented' error code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the property page site

parameters.name: ppUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to the unknown interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call, in this case, it returns E_NOTIMPL indicating the function is not implemented

function.name: PropertyPageSite_TranslateAccelerator
function.description: This function is not implemented yet and returns E_NOTIMPL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the property page site

parameters.name: pMsg
parameters.description: Pointer to the MSG structure

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call, in this case E_NOTIMPL indicating the function is not implemented

function.name: OleCreatePropertyFrameIndirect
function.description: This function creates a property frame and initializes it indirectly with the specified parameters.

parameters.name: lpParams
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure that contains initialization parameters for the property frame.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: OleCreatePropertyFrame
function.description: This function creates a property frame and initializes it with the given parameters.

parameters.name: hwndOwner
parameters.description: Handle to the owner window of the property sheet dialog box.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The horizontal position of the dialog box.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The vertical position of the dialog box.

parameters.name: lpszCaption
parameters.description: Pointer to a string that contains the caption of the dialog box.

parameters.name: cObjects
parameters.description: The count of objects being passed in.

parameters.name: ppUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to the array of objects for which the dialog box displays properties.

parameters.name: cPages
parameters.description: The count of property pages being passed in.

parameters.name: pPageClsID
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of CLSIDs that specify the property pages to display.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: The locale identifier for the property frame.

parameters.name: dwReserved
parameters.description: Reserved. Must be zero.

parameters.name: pvReserved
parameters.description: Reserved. Must be NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns the standard values E_OUTOFMEMORY, E_UNEXPECTED, E_POINTER, and E_FAIL.
